podcast.title: Departure from Roseanne
podcast.body: Due to a "burning hatred" from Rosanne Barr, who was angered by his sole "created by" credit and felt the show was based on her life, Williams faced constant pushback and tantrums. The situation became unworkable, forcing executive producers to choose between him and Barr, leading to Williams being asked to leave in the middle of the first season. "Williams was asked to leave in the middle of the first season."

xref.title: Behind-the-Scenes Conflict with Matt Williams
xref.body: From the beginning, there was trouble behind the scenes. At the premiere screening party, Barr realized the "created by" credit went solely to writer Matt Williams, which enraged her as she felt the show was built around her actual life. This led to a "burning hatred" for Williams, constant pushback, refusal of lines, tantrums, and walking off set. The situation escalated until executive producers Carsey and Werner were forced to choose, resulting in Williams being asked to leave in the middle of the first season. "When the credits flashed up on the screen, Barr realized for the first time that the created by credit went solely to writer Matt Williams."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Control and Backstage Drama with Tom Arnold
xref.body: After Matt Williams left, Barr added her new husband, Tom Arnold, to the writing team. Arnold also played a reoccurring character but was notorious for causing drama backstage. He acted as Barr's "henchman," executing her demands and routine firings. The couple exerted significant power over scripts, rewriting them after each read-through, which caused tension among the constantly changing writing staff. "He was basically served as Barr's henchman, executing her often crazy demands and routine firings."

xref.body: After Matt Williams' departure, Tom Arnold, who was then Rosanne Barr's husband, was added to the writing team for the show. He also played a reoccurring character on the series. "After Williams left, Barr added her new husband, Tom Arnold, to the writing team."
